findings.note_span: Took ibuprofen for back pain for 3–4 days last week.
findings.transcript_evidence: I took some ibuprofen last week for my back. Wait, no, it was naproxen. My brother gave me some of his.
findings.rationale: The note incorrectly records the medication taken as ibuprofen instead of naproxen, which is a critical detail for monitoring lithium levels.
